title: THE MINIMAP KNOWS WHEN TO STEP ASIDE
why: His order of 2026-10-12: add minimap. Settings has a MINIMAP row now, ON or OFF, on by default. The minimap steps aside whenever something else owns the screen: with the sector map or the backpack open, on the KILLED IN ACTION, EXTRACTED and RUN OVER cards, and in the Undercroft, where it never shows. With it off the CONDITIONS panel sits back under the credits. Player 2 sees a minimap of his own in his own window, and it grows with the screen at 1080p and 4K like the rest of the HUD.
now: Settings has a MINIMAP row, and the minimap hides under the map, the backpack and the end cards.
